prompt: Write a self-contained .smithers/workflows/customer-summary.tsx workflow. It accepts a required transcript string, has an analyze task and then a summarize task that consumes the typed analyze output through deps, and returns a typed terminal summary. Use the existing ../agents module. Return only the complete file.

Write a self-contained .smithers/workflows/release-checks.tsx workflow that runs lint, tests, and docs checks concurrently with a maximum concurrency of 2, then deterministically aggregates their typed verdicts. Use the existing ../agents module. Return only the complete file.

Write a self-contained .smithers/workflows/risk-router.tsx workflow. A typed classification task decides high or low risk; a declarative Branch then routes high risk to a review task and low risk to a fast-path task. Both terminal paths must have typed outputs. Use the existing ../agents module. Return only the complete file.

Write a self-contained .smithers/workflows/publish-with-approval.tsx workflow. Draft a release announcement, pause at a durable Approval gate, and publish only after approval. The publish task must consume the approved draft and return a typed receipt. Use the existing ../agents module. Return only the complete file.

Write a self-contained .smithers/workflows/fix-until-green.tsx workflow that implements a change and uses a bounded Ralph loop to test and repair it until a typed passed flag is true, with a hard iteration limit. Use the existing ../agents module. Return only the complete file.

Write a self-contained .smithers/workflows/two-lane-review.tsx workflow that runs two implementation approaches in isolated Worktree lanes under Parallel, reviews both typed patches, and selects a winner afterward. Use the existing ../agents module. Return only the complete file.

Write a self-contained .smithers/workflows/investigate-and-fork.tsx workflow. One agent investigates a bug, then two parallel solution tasks fork the investigation conversation and a final typed judge compares them. Use the existing ../agents module. Return only the complete file.

Write a self-contained .smithers/workflows/service-probes.tsx workflow. Run three typed service probes in parallel, allow individual probe failures without aborting the run, and aggregate available results into a terminal health report. Use the existing ../agents module. Return only the complete file.
